definitions.explanation: A particular time or situation when something happens. Often used in formal contexts.

examples.japanese: {折|おり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あれば→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}します→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧。
examples.english: I'll contact you if the opportunity arises.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{折|おり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{礼|れい}→お礼：01359_orei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧。
examples.english: I would like to express my gratitude on this occasion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{折|おり}を{見|み}て→折を見て：22978_oriwomite⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}→相談：02089_soudan⟧⟦させて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please let me consult with you when there's an opportunity.

notes:
{折|おり} means 'occasion' or 'opportunity' and is used to refer to a suitable or noteworthy time. It has a formal, somewhat literary tone.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {折|おり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あれば→ある：00006_aru⟧: if there's an opportunity
- ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{折|おり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: on this occasion
- ⟦{折|おり}を{見|み}て→折を見て：22978_oriwomite⟧: when the opportunity arises, finding the right moment
- ⟦{折|おり}に{触|ふ}れて→折に触れて：19487_orinifurete⟧: from time to time, on various occasions
- ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{折|おり}: at the time of ~

REGISTER:
Formal and literary. Frequent in business correspondence, speeches, and polite letters. In everyday conversation, {時|とき} or ⟦{機会|きかい}→機会：01302_kikai⟧ are more natural.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {時|とき}: time, when (neutral, everyday)
- ⟦{機会|きかい}→機会：01302_kikai⟧: opportunity, chance (formal but more common in speech)
- ⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧: occasion, time of (formal, similar register to {折|おり})
